method: Read recorded outputs, recount arrays/log entries, and rehash referenced evidence and retained binaries; no new tests or repository changes.

limits: Finite corpus and whole-module byte-op whitelist; no chain/bulk/nominal execution.
Public scalar signatures only; 32 call frames, at most 1M steps and 16MiB live bytes.
Trap and evaluator budget stops retain actual live-resource ledgers; no unwind cleanup claim.
Python Core remains production authority; this is neither a native backend nor a soundness proof.

background.timing_scope: Python lease validation plus native scalar call host elapsed time

limits: The minimum concerns only the complete 146-recipe grammar and encoded bytes, under its trusted ISA-to-HIA model.
Model equivalence uses actual all-input Z3 proofs; finite native probes do not prove assembler/ISA/loader refinement.
Exact allowed encoder bytes and ABI entry mapping are checked after local trusted assembly; arbitrary machine code is rejected.
Flags are caller-clobbered; DF and callee-saved registers stay unchanged. The fixed ret uses the ABI caller stack.
Native timings include C-loop/indirect-call overhead and local host noise. Empirical envelopes are not statistical confidence bounds.
Search/build costs are recorded; no runtime or whole-program global optimum or production hot-code admission is claimed.
Artifacts are locally generated under a trusted host; the ELF checks do not sandbox malicious loaders or same-user filesystem writers.

existing_c_abi_host_ci.scope: Existing finite Hepta C ABI host matrix; does not qualify the new Linux HIA multiversion runtime, NDU integration or x86 instruction search on these other platforms.

reporting_constraints: Unittest failure/error entries can be multiple subtests of one method; never equate them with unique bugs or subtract them to infer passed methods.
Focused, full-suite, crate and qualification tests overlap; do not add them into a purported independent-test total.
1102 migration native result executions are 551 input cases times two implementations; 188 interpreter observations are Python/Rust pairs on a subset.
212 native allocation-fault executions are already included in 1102, not an extra denominator.
NDU uses one shared observation table and paired holdout replay. This does not evaluate sequential learning or establish NDU advantage.
NDU outer call timing and internal adapter timing are separately reported; neither is a whole-program speedup.
Resource-cap checks are admission thresholds; they are not an OS-enforced preemptive CPU/memory quota.
Background actual publication uses explicitly synthetic costs. The measured one-call horizon abstains; no measured speedup follows from publication.
The x86 minimum is only encoded bytes within the declared 146-recipe grammar under the trusted model and encoder; native timing and general optimality are separate.
CFG parity is a finite corpus across18 programs with step/heap/call policies, not a general safety, Rust production admission or native refinement proof.
Nine mechanism gates passing is not six-stage closure, whole-language soundness, unrestricted C/C++ migration or global optimality.
Historical run1 results stay bound to c8c11a4; final claims about c430971 require the complete run2 aggregate and source-unchanged check.
The seven native-host CI jobs qualify the existing finite C ABI matrix, not cross-platform support for the new Linux HIA runtime. Their uploaded ZIPs retain reports/logs, not native executable bytes.
